plan.title: AI Command Center Dashboard Revamp & SOTA Observability Cockpit
plan.goal: Modernize the AI Command Center dashboard to eliminate 500 runtime errors, integrate live SOTA agent telemetry streams (Thought Stream, Intervention Dock, Triage Engine, Effect Sandwiches), and deliver a high-clarity operator experience adhering to Impeccable design standards.
success_criteria: 100% of the 97 monitored dashboard endpoints return HTTP 200 via scripts/testing/verify-dashboard-apis.py
Dynamic Python 3.13 module loading imports cleanly with sys.modules registration
Live thought stream, human intervention dock, and triage monitor panels active in dashboard.html
Tier-0 validation gate passes with zero regressions

phases.name: Backend Route Resiliency & Dynamic Import Fix
phases.goal: Fix dynamic import sys.modules registrations in aistack.py and achieve 97/97 API pass rate

phases.name: SOTA Cockpit Cards & Telemetry Panels
phases.goal: Wire Thought Stream, Intervention Dock, and Triage metrics into dashboard.html and dashboard.js

phases.name: Impeccable Visual Polish & Resilient Fallbacks
phases.goal: Apply OKLCH styling, responsive glassmorphism, and structured error fallback badges

items.name: Fix dynamic import sys.modules registrations in aistack.py
items.goal: Register all dynamic module specs into sys.modules to prevent Python 3.13 dataclass inspection crashes on /api/aistack/advanced/runtime-summary

items.name: Mount SOTA Thought Stream and Intervention Dock cards in dashboard.html
items.goal: Add responsive HUD cards for real-time thought streaming, intervention controls, and triage engine latency

items.goal: Update dashboard.js with structured fallbacks for inactive endpoints, remove broken stubs, and apply refined OKLCH aesthetics
